before = last_transition.before_frame
after = last_transition.after_frame
def summarize(nodes):
    return {n['hash']: (n['id'], n['color'], n['pixels'], tuple(map(tuple, n['boundary']))) for n in nodes}
sb = summarize(before.segmentation['nodes'])
sa = summarize(after.segmentation['nodes'])
diff = []

    if h not in sb:
        diff.append(('added', h, sa[h]))

        diff.append(('removed', h, sb[h]))
    else:
        if sb[h]!=sa[h]:
            diff.append(('changed', h, sb[h], sa[h]))
print('diff count', len(diff))
for d in diff:
    print(d)
